summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Add IT Solutions consulting site. All 9 backend pytest cases passed (100%) and all critical UI flows passed (sections present, mobile nav with 6 links, accordion expansion, animated counters, conditional resource dropdown, consultation form submission with sonner success toast). Third-party integrations correctly return 'skipped' for telegram/email/google_sheets when env vars are blank.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] (KeyError if missing). Acceptable given .env present, and follows 'fail fast' guideline.
Footer WhatsApp/secondary CTA is correctly styled as text link (no green button) — matches spec.
ConsultationForm uses Field component with id->data-testid mapping (form-full-name, form-business-email, etc.) — good test surface coverage.
list_leads excludes mongo _id via projection {'_id': 0} — clean.
Telegram/Email/Sheets fan-out runs concurrently with asyncio.gather and never raises — form always succeeds even if integrations fail. Good resiliency.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed leads via POST /api/leads during testing; lead data is non-destructive and prefixed for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_leads_api.py — re-run with `pytest backend/tests/test_leads_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. UI Playwright covered: section presence, mobile hamburger (6 links: Home/Services/Agile/PMO/Resources/Contact), anchor scrolling, resources accordion (9 items, expandable), animated trust metric counters (verified 200+ after scroll-into-view), consultation form conditional resource dropdown, full submission flow returning 'Consultation request received...' sonner toast. WhatsApp link is text-only (no bright green) as required.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All specified test scenarios passed.
